description: This is a shell script used for Dynamic DNS (DDNS) updates, including configuration preparation, update logic, and service control for DDNS on a network device.

methods.name: prepare_ddns_config_file
methods.description: Prepares the configuration file for the DDNS update client based on system configuration.

methods.name: prepare_extra_commandline_params
methods.description: Builds additional command-line parameters for the ez-ipupdate command based on configuration.

methods.name: update_ddns_server
methods.description: Executes the DDNS update process, returns status codes based on success or specific errors.

methods.name: do_start
methods.description: Determines if a DDNS update is needed based on IP change or time interval, and initiates update if required.

methods.name: update_ddns_if_needed
methods.description: Checks if the network conditions and previous errors allow for a new DDNS update, and triggers update accordingly.

methods.name: service_init
methods.description: Initializes the DDNS service by retrieving required configuration parameters.

calls: utctx_cmd get ddns_enable wan_last_ipaddr ddns_last_update ddns_update_days ddns_mx ddns_mx_backup ddns_wildcard
